Memory pages connect virtual addresses to physical storage.
A page table records the location and permissions of each page.
When a required page is absent, the processor raises a page fault.
The operating system locates the data and updates the mapping.
File mappings let a program access file contents through memory addresses.
Clean file pages can be discarded and loaded again when needed.
Dirty anonymous pages require a different reclamation strategy.
